takes.h: The Exorcist: Martyrs rated R ahead of its March 12, 2027 release
takes.p: Dread Central reports Mike Flanagan’s The Exorcist: Martyrs has received an R rating for bloody violent content, grisly images, language and some sexual references. Flanagan wrote and directed; Scarlett Johansson stars as detective Julie Miller, with John Leguizamo as Father Sunday. The film opens in theaters March 12, 2027.
